name: Bordeaux
about: The Atlantic keeps things mild and touring comfortable most of the year, wetter in winter, with the vendange (harvest) in Sep–Oct.
overview: The world's most famous wine region, built around grand châteaux — Médoc, Saint-Émilion, and Pomerol — ringing a UNESCO-listed old town.
costOverview: A casual bistro meal is reasonable — a proper château tour and tasting is a real, planned expense, not an impulse stop.

specialSeasons.text: Grape harvest is underway across the chateaux — some offer grape-picking experiences alongside the usual tastings.
